verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a virtual mailbox and address-compliance service, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers and uses their tools is the agent role, which is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows any built-in agent or MCP-client capability; the Zapier and API mentions are integrations, not MCP tool consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
